failure_stage: rolling 7/28/90-day flight-number histories after all 96 source partitions were verified and aggregated
exception: numpy._core._exceptions._ArrayMemoryError: unable to allocate 541 MiB for an array with shape (4, 35487278) and data type float32
root_cause: The Pandas groupby-rolling implementation materialized 35,487,278 flight-number/date aggregates in memory. Although correct for smaller feature levels, its peak contiguous-memory requirement is unsuitable for the 43.8-million-flight census.
impact: No lookup Parquet or manifest was emitted. The empty create-only output directory was moved intact to the failure quarantine.
resolution: Use a new v2 identifier and an out-of-core DuckDB RANGE-window backend with bounded memory, annual atomic exports, and the same closed-left calendar semantics. Retain the Pandas backend for small deterministic unit tests.
